sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Get your money’s worth.
sentences.ipa: /gˌet jɔː mˈʌniːz wˈɜːθ./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: read about family money management;
sentences.ipa: /rˈed əbˈaʊt fˈæmɪliː mˈʌniː mˈænɪdʒmənt;/
sentences.meaning: 阅读关于家庭理财的内容；

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: learn about the history of money;
sentences.ipa: /lˈɜːn əbˈaʊt ðə hˈɪstəriː ɒv mˈʌniː;/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: describe our shopping habits and money management;
sentences.ipa: /dɪskrˈaɪb ˌaʊə ʃˈɒpɪŋ hˈæbɪts ænd mˈʌniː mˈænɪdʒmənt;/
sentences.meaning: 描述我们的购物习惯和理财方式；

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: understand how to manage money well.
sentences.ipa: /ˌʌndəstˈænd hˌaʊ tə mˈænɪdʒ mˈʌniː wˈel./
sentences.meaning: 懂得如何妥善管理钱财。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Money plays an important role in our lives.
sentences.ipa: /mˈʌniː plˈeɪz ən ɪmpˈɔːtənt rˈəʊl ɪn ˌaʊə lˈaɪvz./
sentences.meaning: 金钱对我们的生活起着重要作用。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Let’s learn about money and how to manage it well.
sentences.ipa: /lˈets lˈɜːn əbˈaʊt mˈʌniː ænd hˌaʊ tə mˈænɪdʒ ɪt wˈel./
sentences.meaning: 让我们了解金钱，并学习如何合理管理金钱。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Look at the pictures below.
sentences.ipa: /lˈʊk æt ðə pˈɪktʃəz bɪlˈəʊ./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A The Class 1, Grade 7 students are learning about money around the world.
sentences.ipa: /ə ðə klˈɑːs wˈʌn, grˈeɪd sˈevən stjˈuːdnts ɑː lˈɜːnɪŋ əbˈaʊt mˈʌniː ərˈaʊnd ðə wˈɜːld./
sentences.meaning: 一年级7年级的学生在世界各地学习钱学问。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Match each country and its money with the correct gift.
sentences.ipa: /mˈætʃ ˈiːtʃ kˈʌntriː ænd ɪts mˈʌniː wɪð ðə kərˈekt gˈɪft./
sentences.meaning: 将每个国家及其资金与正确的天赋相匹配。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: tea baseball cap
sentences.ipa: /tˈiː bˈeɪsbɔːl kˈæp/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Russian dolls
sentences.ipa: /rˈʌʃən dˈɒlz/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Work in pairs and talk about popular gifts from different countries.
sentences.ipa: /wˈɜːk ɪn pˈeəz ænd tˈɔːk əbˈaʊt pˈɒpjʊlə gˈɪfts frɒm dˈɪfərənt kˈʌntriːz./
sentences.meaning: 成对地工作，谈论不同国家的流行礼物。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Simon and Millie are talking about the gifts above.
sentences.ipa: /bˈiː saɪmən ænd mˈɪliː ɑː tˈɔːkɪŋ əbˈaʊt ðə gˈɪfts əbˈʌv./
sentences.meaning: B赛门和米莉在谈论上面的礼物。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Use the conversation below as a model.
sentences.ipa: /jˈuːz ðə kˌɒnvəsˈeɪʃən bɪlˈəʊ æz ə mˈɒdəl./

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: Which gift do you like, Millie?
sentences.ipa: /wˌɪtʃ gˈɪft dˈuː juː lˈaɪk, mˈɪliː?/

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: I love those Russian dolls.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ lˈʌv ðəʊz rˈʌʃən dˈɒlz./
sentences.meaning: 我喜欢那些俄罗斯娃娃。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: What’s special about them?
sentences.ipa: /wˌɒts spˈeʃl əbˈaʊt ðˌem?/

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: They’re a set of dolls in different sizes. Usually they come one inside another, from the biggest to the smallest. They’re colourful and full of surprises. What about you, Simon?
sentences.ipa: /ðˌeə ə sˈet ɒv dˈɒlz ɪn dˈɪfərənt sˈaɪzɪz. jˈuːʒʊəliː ðeɪ kˈʌm wˈʌn ˌɪnsˈaɪd ənˈʌðə, frɒm ðə bˈɪgɪst tə ðə smˈɔːlɪst. ðˌeə kˈʌləfʊl ænd fˈʊl ɒv səprˈaɪzɪz. wˌɒt əbˈaʊt juː, saɪmən?/
sentences.meaning: 它们是一套大小不一的娃娃。 通常它们从最大的到最小的，它们相互内在。它们色彩鲜艳，充满惊喜。你呢，西蒙？

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: I love baseball caps. Players wear them to protect their eyes from the sun, and they’re also a kind of fashion.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ lˈʌv bˈeɪsbɔːl kˈæps. plˈeɪəz wˈeə ðˌem tə prətˈekt ðeə ˈaɪz frɒm ðə sˈʌn, ænd ðeə ˈɔːlsəʊ ə kˈaɪnd ɒv fˈæʃən./
sentences.meaning: 我喜欢棒球帽，玩家戴着棒球帽是为了保护眼睛免受太阳的侵袭，他们也是时尚的一种。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C What other countries’ money do you know?
sentences.ipa: /sˈiː wˌɒt ˈʌðə kˈʌntriːz” mˈʌniː dˈuː juː nˈəʊ?/
sentences.meaning: C. 其他国家有哪些钱？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Family money management
sentences.ipa: /fˈæmɪliː mˈʌniː mˈænɪdʒmənt/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Simon is talking to his mum about how his family manages their money.
sentences.ipa: /saɪmən ɪz tˈɔːkɪŋ tə hɪz mˈʌm əbˈaʊt hˌaʊ hɪz fˈæmɪliː mˈænɪdʒɪz ðeə mˈʌniː./
sentences.meaning: 西蒙在和他妈妈说他的家人怎么管理他们的钱

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Read their conversation.
sentences.ipa: /rˈiːd ðeə kˌɒnvəsˈeɪʃən./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Before reading, think about the questions below.
sentences.ipa: /bɪfˈɔː rˈiːdɪŋ, θˈɪŋk əbˈaʊt ðə kwˈestʃənz bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 在阅读前，考虑下面的问题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 Does your family make plans for using money?
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn dˈʌz jɔː fˈæmɪliː mˌeɪk plˈænz fɔː jˈuːzɪŋ mˈʌniː?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 What do you think your family spends the most money on every year?
sentences.ipa: /tˈuː wˌɒt dˈuː juː θˈɪŋk jɔː fˈæmɪliː spˈendz ðə mˈəʊst mˈʌniː ˌɒn ˈevəriː jˈɪə?/
sentences.meaning: 2，你认为你的家人每年花的钱最多吗？

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: There’s a new mall across the street. Let’s go shopping.
sentences.ipa: /ðˌeəz ə njˈuː mˈæl əkrˈɒs ðə strˈiːt. lˈets gˌəʊ ʃˈɒpɪŋ./
sentences.meaning: 街对面有个新的购物中心。我们去购物吧。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: OK. Can I have a new pair of sports shoes?
sentences.ipa: /ˌəʊkˈeɪ. kˌæn ˌaɪ hæv ə njˈuː pˈeə ɒv spˈɔːts ʃˈuːz?/
sentences.meaning: 好，我可以换双运动鞋吗？

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: Of course. And we also need a new computer.
sentences.ipa: /ˌɒv kˈɔːs. ˌænd wiː ˈɔːlsəʊ nˈiːd ə njˈuː kəmpjˈuːtə./
sentences.meaning: 当然，我们还需要一台新的电脑。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: That will cost a lot of money.
sentences.ipa: /ðˈæt wɪl kˈɒst ə lˈɒt ɒv mˈʌniː./

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: Don’t worry. Your dad and I manage money well. We make a budget every year.
sentences.ipa: /dˈəʊnt wˈʌriː. jˌɔː dˈæd ænd ˌaɪ mˈænɪdʒ mˈʌniː wˈel. wˌiː mˌeɪk ə bˈʌdʒɪt ˈevəriː jˈɪə./
sentences.meaning: 别担心，你老爸和我钱管理得很好，我们每年都做一个预算。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: What’s in the budget?
sentences.ipa: /wˌɒts ɪn ðə bˈʌdʒɪt?/

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: Well … we need to cover your education first. Then we have to pay for our flat, car, food and other daily needs every month. All these cost about 50 per cent of our budget.
sentences.ipa: /wˈel … wiː nˈiːd tə kˈʌvə jɔː ˌedjʊkˈeɪʃən fˈɜːst. ðˈen wiː hæv tə pˈeɪ fɔː ˌaʊə flˈæt, kˈɑː, fˈuːd ænd ˈʌðə dˈeɪliː nˈiːdz ˈevəriː mˈʌnθ. ˈɔːl ðiːz kˈɒst əbˈaʊt fˈɪftiː pɜː sˈent ɒv ˌaʊə bˈʌdʒɪt./
sentences.meaning: 我们每月必须支付我们的公寓、汽车、食品和其他日常需求，所有这些费用大约占我们预算的50%。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: Where does the other half go?
sentences.ipa: /wˌeə dˈʌz ðiː ˈʌðə hˈɑːf gˌəʊ?/

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: We spend about 30 per cent on special things.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː spˈend əbˈaʊt θˈɜːtiː pɜː sˈent ˌɒn spˈeʃl θˈɪŋz./
sentences.meaning: 我们花费大约30%用于特殊事务。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: Like what?
sentences.ipa: /lˈaɪk wˌɒt?/

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: Like taking holidays. Holidays can be expensive.
sentences.ipa: /lˈaɪk tˈeɪkɪŋ hˈɒlɪdeɪz. hˈɒlɪdeɪz kæn biː ɪkspˈensɪv./
sentences.meaning: 比如休假 假期可能很贵的

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: Do we save any money?
sentences.ipa: /dˈuː wiː sˈeɪv ˈeniː mˈʌniː?/

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: Of course. We leave about 20 per cent in our bank account. It’s a good idea to save for a rainy day.
sentences.ipa: /ˌɒv kˈɔːs. wˌiː lˈiːv əbˈaʊt twˈentiː pɜː sˈent ɪn ˌaʊə bˈæŋk əkˈaʊnt. ˌɪts ə gˈʊd aɪdˈɪə tə sˈeɪv fɔː ə rˈeɪniː dˈeɪ./
sentences.meaning: 当然，我们把20%左右的存款留在我们的银行账户里。 节省一个下雨日是好主意。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: I see.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ sˈiː./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Label the parts of the chart about his family budget, and write the correct percentage next to each label.
sentences.ipa: /lˈeɪbəl ðə pˈɑːts ɒv ðə tʃˈɑːt əbˈaʊt hɪz fˈæmɪliː bˈʌdʒɪt, ænd rˈaɪt ðə kərˈekt pəsˈentɪdʒ nˈekst tʊ ˈiːtʃ lˈeɪbəl./
sentences.meaning: 标注图表中有关他家庭预算的部分，并在每个标签旁边写出正确的百分比。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A Here is a pie chart about Simon’s family budget.
sentences.ipa: /ə hˈɪə ɪz ə pˈaɪ tʃˈɑːt əbˈaʊt saɪmən s fˈæmɪliː bˈʌdʒɪt./
sentences.meaning: 以下是关于西蒙家庭预算的馅饼图。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then fill in the details in the chart.
sentences.ipa: /ðˈen fˈɪl ˈɪn ðə dˈiːteɪlz ɪn ðə tʃˈɑːt./
sentences.meaning: 然后填写图表中的细节。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Simon’s family budget
sentences.ipa: /saɪmən s fˈæmɪliː bˈʌdʒɪt/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Read the conversation again and answer the questions below.
sentences.ipa: /bˈiː rˈiːd ðə kˌɒnvəsˈeɪʃən əgˈen ænd ˈɑːnsə ðə kwˈestʃənz bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: B再读一次谈话，回答下面的问题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 What does Simon’s mum need to buy in the new mall?
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn wˌɒt dˈʌz saɪmən s mˈʌm nˈiːd tə bˈaɪ ɪn ðə njˈuː mˈæl?/
sentences.meaning: 1 Simon的妈妈在新商场需要买什么？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 How does Simon’s family manage their money?
sentences.ipa: /tˈuː hˌaʊ dˈʌz saɪmən s fˈæmɪliː mˈænɪdʒ ðeə mˈʌniː?/
sentences.meaning: 2 Simon的家人如何管理他们的钱？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 What comes first in Simon’s family budget?
sentences.ipa: /θrˈiː wˌɒt kˈʌmz fˈɜːst ˈɪn saɪmən s fˈæmɪliː bˈʌdʒɪt?/
sentences.meaning: 3 西蒙的家庭预算排名第一的是什么呢？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 4 What is an example of a special thing in Simon’s family?
sentences.ipa: /fˈɔː wˌɒt ɪz ən ɪgzˈɑːmpəl ɒv ə spˈeʃl θˈɪŋ ˈɪn saɪmən s fˈæmɪliː?/
sentences.meaning: 4 西蒙家有什么特殊之处？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 5 What does Simon’s mum mean by saying “to save for a rainy day”?
sentences.ipa: /fˈaɪv wˌɒt dˈʌz saɪmən s mˈʌm mˈiːn baɪ sˈeɪɪŋ “tə sˈeɪv fɔː ə rˈeɪniː dˈeɪ”?/
sentences.meaning: 5 Simon的妈妈说“为雨天省钱”是什么意思？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Complete the blog post with the correct forms of the words and phrases in the box below.
sentences.ipa: /kəmplˈiːt ðə blˈɒg pˈəʊst wɪð ðə kərˈekt fˈɔːmz ɒv ðə wˈɜːdz ænd frˈeɪzɪz ɪn ðə bˈɒks bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 在博客文章中填写以下框中文字和短语的正确形式。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C Simon is reading his friend John’s blog post about his family budget.
sentences.ipa: /sˈiː saɪmən ɪz rˈiːdɪŋ hɪz frˈend dʒˈɒnz blˈɒg pˈəʊst əbˈaʊt hɪz fˈæmɪliː bˈʌdʒɪt./
sentences.meaning: C Simon 正在阅读朋友 John 写的关于家庭预算的博客文章。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Money matters in every family.
sentences.ipa: /mˈʌniː mˈætəz ɪn ˈevəriː fˈæmɪliː./
sentences.meaning: 金钱在每一个家庭都很重要。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: money well.
sentences.ipa: /mˈʌniː wˈel./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: things like our house and car.
sentences.ipa: /θˈɪŋz lˈaɪk ˌaʊə hˈaʊs ænd kˈɑː./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: budget.
sentences.ipa: /bˈʌdʒɪt./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: day”.
sentences.ipa: /dˈeɪ”./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I think that is a great idea.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ θˈɪŋk ðˈæt ɪz ə grˈeɪt aɪdˈɪə./
sentences.meaning: 我认为这是一个好主意。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D Think about the questions below.
sentences.ipa: /dˈiː θˈɪŋk əbˈaʊt ðə kwˈestʃənz bɪlˈəʊ./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Share your answers with your classmates.
sentences.ipa: /ʃˈeə jɔː ˈɑːnsəz wɪð jɔː klˈɑːsmeɪts./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 What do you think of Simon’s family budget?
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn wˌɒt dˈuː juː θˈɪŋk ɒv saɪmən s fˈæmɪliː bˈʌdʒɪt?/
sentences.meaning: 1你觉得西蒙的家庭预算怎么样？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 Make a budget for your family.
sentences.ipa: /tˈuː mˌeɪk ə bˈʌdʒɪt fɔː jɔː fˈæmɪliː./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: What is in your budget?
sentences.ipa: /wˌɒt ɪz ɪn jɔː bˈʌdʒɪt?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 Do you think it is important to make a budget?
sentences.ipa: /θrˈiː dˈuː juː θˈɪŋk ɪt ɪz ɪmpˈɔːtənt tə mˌeɪk ə bˈʌdʒɪt?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Why or why not?
sentences.ipa: /wˌaɪ ɔː wˌaɪ nˌɒt?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Simon is talking to his mum before they go to the supermarket.
sentences.ipa: /saɪmən ɪz tˈɔːkɪŋ tə hɪz mˈʌm bɪfˈɔː ðeɪ gˌəʊ tə ðə sˈuːpəmˌɑːkɪt./
sentences.meaning: 在他们去超市之前 Simon正在和他妈妈说话

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Here is their conversation.
sentences.ipa: /hˈɪə ɪz ðeə kˌɒnvəsˈeɪʃən./

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: Let’s go to the supermarket. We need some meat,... and also some fruit and vegetables.
sentences.ipa: /lˈets gˌəʊ tə ðə sˈuːpəmˌɑːkɪt. wˌiː nˈiːd sˌʌm mˈiːt,... ænd ˈɔːlsəʊ sˌʌm frˈuːt ænd vˈedʒɪtəbəlz./
sentences.meaning: 让我们去超市吧，我们需要一些肉，还有水果和蔬菜。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We can use some in questions when we are making offers or requests.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː kæn jˈuːz sˌʌm ɪn kwˈestʃənz wˌen wiː ɑː mˈeɪkɪŋ ˈɒfəz ɔː rɪkwˈests./
sentences.meaning: 当我们提出要约或请求时，我们可以在问题中使用一些。

sentences.speaker: narrator
